title: Reading music versus ear in Kelly's and Petit's bands
summary: Kelly's band played a chorus from stock music and improvised; neither Kelly nor Petit relied on music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Um, is there anything else about Buddy Petit's style that you can tell? Did he, uh, oh, I was gonna ask you about Chris. Did he ever, first of all, did Chris ever use music very much? Any special, uh, stock arrangements or any other special arrangements written out? Or did he, just everything mostly, the head, did you all play?

Well, we used to play the chorus. See, in them days you had three parts on the music. You had your, oh, yeah, I've seen those. Indiduction, you had your, then your chorus, then you had a special chorus down there. But we usually just play that one special chorus. Start, start at the chorus and play that. Stay right there.
And go ahead and make up all the rest of the part.
Mm-hmm. No, he wasn't too much of a music man. I'll be frank with him. I didn't mean, Daddy. No. No, Chris wasn't too much of a music man.
Did Buddy Petty read much? Did he have, usually read from the music when he had his own band if you remember? When he played with Milton did you all have parts arranged or written out?
No. That was on his last lineup but in his hey days. I'm sure I wasn't too much on the music.
Well I guess he didn't need too much music to make all that stuff up.
No, the people didn't like it. No way. People like that jazz. Them fellas used to give it to them.
